title: Clones in the Machine: A Feminist Critique of Agency in Digital Cloning

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation using feminist theories of agency to critique how digital clones overlook relational dynamics, power structures, and context-specific behaviors shaped by gender identity.

Theoretical critique highlighting how the reductionist logic of digital cloning ignores exclusions based on ethnic identity, drawing parallels to historical instances of exploitative data extraction from oppressed groups.
